mettle.perk.smithing.tinker.description: Anvil repairs and renames cost %s fewer levels (never below 1).
mettle.perk.smithing.thrifty.description: A recipe with ingots gives one back %s%% of the time.
mettle.perk.smithing.light_hand.descript: Armour you craft weighs 25%% less, whoever wears it.
mettle.perk.smithing.riveted.description: Armour and shields you craft last 30%% longer.
mettle.perk.smithing.proofed.description: Each armour piece you craft gives +1 armour (+4 for a full set).
mettle.perk.smithing.shieldwright.descri: Shields you craft raise instantly and wear half as fast.
mettle.perk.smithing.forged.description: Tools and weapons you craft last 25%% longer and carry your name: “Forged by …”.
mettle.perk.smithing.salvager.descriptio: An unenchanted iron, gold or copper piece alone in a grindstone grinds down to nuggets: up to half its metal, less the more worn it is.
mettle.perk.smithing.keen_edge.descripti: Swords, spears, axes and maces you craft deal +1 damage.
mettle.perk.smithing.true_temper.descrip: Pickaxes, axes, shovels and hoes you craft dig 15%% faster.
mettle.perk.smithing.reforge.description: At a smithing table with no template, armour and a feather, an ingot or an amethyst shard is reforged Light (half the weight), Sturdy (lasts 50%% longer) or Warded (+1 toughness).
mettle.perk.smithing.masterwork.descript: One in ten tools, weapons and armour pieces you craft is a Masterwork: +1 to its main stat, a third more durability and a gold name.
mettle.perk.smithing.honing.description: A weapon or tool alone in a grindstone’s top slot is honed, enchantments kept: weapons deal +2 damage for 60 hits, tools dig 30%% faster for 300 blocks. The bottom slot grinds as before.
mettle.perk.smithing.hundred_hammers.des: Anvil repairs and renames never charge or add the “prior work” cost.
mettle.perk.smithing.hundred_hammers.hin: A smith is made at the anvil, one piece at a time.
mettle.perk.smithing.black_iron.descript: Netherite upgrades you make hand the template back one time in three.
mettle.perk.smithing.black_iron.hint: The hardest metal asks the most of you.
mettle.perk.smithing.folded_steel.descri: Iron tools, weapons and armour you craft last twice as long.
mettle.perk.smithing.folded_steel.hint: Taught by a city’s smith, or found in A Treatise on Folded Steel.
mettle.smithing.tooltip.masterwork: Masterwork by %s · +1 %s, a third more durability
mettle.smithing.tooltip.shieldwright: Shieldwright · raises instantly, wears half as fast
mettle.smithing.tooltip.folded_steel: Folded Steel · lasts twice as long
mettle.smithing.tooltip.brittle_edge: Brittle Edge · +2 damage, half the durability
